claim_ceiling: TF-IDF family (8 representations) evaluated at 174k scale with frozen adversarial benchmarks. Production default (cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5) passes both adversarial gates (language_dominance=0.477, jurist_preference=0.735). Citation heritage benchmark fails for all TF-IDF reps (AUC~0.5, recall@20~0.05-0.07) due to sparse citation graph (0.1% coverage). v17b label normalization does not generalize to 174k fine-grained labels (zoom_fine degrades for 4/8 reps). All reps fail cross-language retrieval, cluster coherence, hierarchy alignment, and boilerplate resistance. No dense/metric-learning representations available at 174k yet.
evidence_summary: Formal suite results (8 TF-IDF reps, 12 benchmarks, HNSW artifact fixed via exact k-NN on stratified n=2000): 8/8 PASS run_174k_formal_suite adversarial (jurist_would_succeed_rate), 4/8 PASS formal suite v25 adversarial_falsification (branch_coherence). Citation heritage: 137k pairs, all reps AUC~0.50-0.53, recall@20~0.05-0.07, FAIL. v17b normalization: 85,819 labels, 214->164 areas, hierarchy ratio=1.0 all reps, zoom_fine degrades >10% for 4/8 reps (worst full_text_tfidf_light 0.835). Cross-language: ALL FAIL (recall@10~0.12-0.14 < 0.2). Cluster coherence: ALL FAIL (purity~0.28-0.36 < 0.7). Hierarchy: ALL FAIL (L0 NMI<0.03). Boilerplate: ALL FAIL (resistance~-0.76 to -0.84). Dense embeddings: 3/26 years only. Negative results honestly represented. Documentation inconsistencies (pair count 1020 vs 137314, accepted_run_id drift) are minor pre-existing issues.
